content.title: Asmodeus
content.body:
§lHow to Summon
    - Dimension: End
    - Blocks Required:
      1. (1) Aberrant Soulcube
      2. (16) Obsidian
      3. (4) Diamond Blocks
    
      - Arrangement (G=Ground, D=Diamond, S=Soulcube, O=Obsidian, X=Air)
    §lFront POV:
    X X §lO §rX X
    §lD §rX §lO §rX §lD
    §lO §rX §lS §rX §lO
    §lO §rX §lO §rX §lO
    §lO §rX §lO §rX §lO
    §lG G G G G
    |
    §lTop-down POV:
    §lD §rX X X §lD
    X X X X X
    X X §lO §rX X
    X X X X X  
    §lD §rX X X §lD

    After building the altar, use a §lSoul Key §rto trigger the fight.

    §lRecommended Gear
      1. Latest Armor for every class.
      2. Protection IV on most armor pieces.
      3. If possible, also enchant armor with Vitae and Vitality.
      4. Fully enchanted weapons.
      5. Shield of Honor.
      6. The Cataclysmic Arrow/The Interdimensional Soldier's Charm/The Interdimensional Runner's Charm.
      7. Forsaken Ring of Strength/Archery/Magic Focus.
      8. Fully Upgraded Magic Wands of every element.
      9. Lots of healing.
      10. (Bonus) XP level 100 for 10% improvements to all stats.
    §lBossfight:
    Phase 1: Asmodeus will shoot a barrage of projectiles at you while occasionally also releasing outwards a ring of projectiles.
    Phase 2: Asmodeus summons Astaroths that will create a shield around him until they're destroyed.
    Phase 3: The Astaroths will instead heal Asmodeus, and Grells will also begin to get summoned.
